This is one of the three [[quest]]s given by [[Image of Zinn]] from the [[Golem User Manual]]. This one deals with neutralizing [[P.O.X.]] and retrieving its power crystal. The [[Jade Brotherhood]] purchased the P.O.X. golem to use as a weapon in their war against the [[Am Fah]]. However, P.O.X.'s original programming could activate at any time, causing it to complete its ultimate objective: assassinate the [[Emperor Kisu]]. According to [[Zinn]], the accidental creator of this killer golem, the P.O.X. model has built-in boosters allowing him to reach the [[Imperial Sanctum]] in a matter of seconds! You must deactivate the golem before the program kicks in. Seek out a guardsman in [[the Marketplace]] for help finding the Jade Brotherhood compound.

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Speak with [[Guardsman Makuruyo]] in The Marketplace.

=== Reward ===
* [[Zinn's Task#objectives|P.O.X.'s Power Crystal]]

== Walkthrough ==
Follow your new [[Jade Brotherhood]] allies and assist them in killing the [[Am Fah]]. Head West along the shore and cross the bridge to the island with [[Lian, Dragon's Petal]]. Defend against the onslaught of the Am Fah. After they have been killed head west again towards the area with the two bosses and their mobs. Be careful of drop-downs on the way. Then head North-West towards [[P.O.X.]] and the Jade Brotherhood that purchased it. Simply attack P.O.X to 20% hp and take the crystal to end the mission.

If you are doing this quest with heroes/henchmen, it is recommended that you take a Minion Master, as the many minions will provide a buffer zone to protect your healer/casters from the numerous Am Fah Assassins. Also, for the last battle against the P.O.X golem, it is recommended that you take an interrupt hero to stop the golem from using [[Reactor Blast]], which could easily wipe the whole party if it is not prepared. When using henchmen, a fool-proof way of defeating P.O.X. is that when it starts casting his Reactor Blast skill, flag all henchmen/heroes away, using the minimap. After the casting is finished, just remove the flag and let them return.

Note: P.O.X. cannot be knocked down.

It is possible to run past all the Am Fah mobs and run straight to P.O.X.. The fight with P.O.X. will trigger normally, and the quest will be complete after defeating P.O.X.. It is recommended to use party-wide running skills, such as [["Charge!"]], to bypass the Am Fah easily. After P.O.X. is defeated and everyone has collected the power crystal, the "mission completed" countdown may not appear, but the quest is properly completed.

== Notes ==
* Throughout this mission, [[human]] [[party]] members will be under the [[Jade Brotherhood Disguise]] effect and all Jade Brotherhood will be allies. [[Wing, Three Blade]] will turn aggressive but [[Lian, Dragon's Petal|Lian, Dragon Petal]] will not.
* After P.O.X. goes haywire the disguise will wear off and you will be set upon by the Jade Brotherhood.
* It is possible to capture [[elite skill]]s from the Jade Brotherhood [[boss]]es when they die.
* Whenever you pass by Jade Brotherhood guards while under the disguise, they do the /salute [[emote]].
* [[M.O.X.]] is not required to be in your party for this quest.
* If a Jade Brotherhood boss dies, you will still gain a morale boost even though they are your allies.
* This quest is obtained automatically after accepting [[Zinn's Task]]. If it is abandoned, it can be re-obtained by asking Image of Zinn about the Zinn's Task quest. The initial dialogue can only be seen in the quest log, and it has no accept, decline or when asked about dialogue.
* Sometimes, an Am Fah assassin will not attack if attacked by range.
* Although this quest happens predominantly in Wajjun Bazaar, certain changes have been made to the normal explorable area.
** The map denotes this location as Wa'''i'''jun Bazaar, instead of  Wa'''j'''jun Bazaar.
** There are various "territory" markers for both the Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood.
** Some walkways that are normally open have been blocked by debris.
* If you keep the quest active, the groups of Am Fah can be farmed for [[Bolt of Cloth|Bolts of Cloth]], [[Bolt of Linen|Bolts of Linen]], and [[Plague Idol]]s. [[Category:Quests useful for farming]]

{{bug|Sometimes after [[P.O.X.]] goes haywire you cannot interact because whenever you click it automatically makes you use your first [[skill]].}}
